usedFor: Infinity holds project items, and Instagram for Business receives a video or Reel through “Post Video or Reel”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Item” in Infinity, then “Post Video or Reel” in Instagram for Business
bestTemplate.why: A new item can trigger a video post, so publishing follows the item that planned it.

watchOut: “New Item” in Infinity is polling, so “Post Video or Reel” publishes after a scheduled check.
